evidence.detail: latest_decks() uses LIMIT 500 AND d.created_date > UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY); if 500+ non-tournament decks were created in that window, no tournament decks are returned

home page iterates the deck list from latest_decks() to find the first Gatherling competition_id; if none appear in the list, tournament_decks stays empty and the 'Latest Tournament Top 8' section is omitted
bakert comment confirms root cause: 'This is because we grab the last 500 decks. If the most recent 500 decks does not include any tournament decks we won't get the tournament.'

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/deck.py, remove the 'created_date > UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)' clause from latest_decks() so that all seasons' recent decks up to LIMIT 500 are considered, ensuring low-volume tournament weeks still appear. Alternatively, load the most recent completed tournament's decks via a separate load_competitions() query in decksite/main.py and pass them to Home alongside the latest_decks list.
triage.notes: Removing the 30-day filter is the one-line fix. The separate-query approach is safer if high deck volume returns; either is under 20 changed lines with no schema changes.
